d_phrases_text: The key stored on this computer is gone. Enter your three recovery phrases to open your profile again.
d_first_text: Enter your first name and press Create. The app draws three recovery phrases from a book and shows them: write them down before going on.
d_soon: This screen is not on the desktop client yet.
d_notif_hint: Shows a small window with a quick reply when a message arrives and the window is not open. Muted conversations stay silent.
d_startup_hint: FreeSpeech starts with the computer, hidden in the notification area, to receive your messages. Switch off to start it by hand.
d_diag_hint: Record on this computer what the application does (connections, refusals, sends) for a bug report. Never content, keys or full identifiers. Nothing is sent.
d_restart_text: The language is read at start: restart FreeSpeech now?
